name: Jiali Scroll to Top Button
author: Mahyar

sections.description:
Smooth Scroll to Top is a simple yet powerful WordPress plugin that adds a customizable “Scroll to Top” button to your website. Users can smoothly scroll back to the top of the page with a single click, enhancing site navigation and user experience.

✨ Features:

– ✅ Fully customizable button: change size, color, position, and shape
– ✅ Smooth scrolling effect for better UX
– ✅ Positioning options: left or right with adjustable distances
– ✅ Shape selection: square or circular button
– ✅ No coding required—easy admin panel settings
– ✅ Lightweight and optimized for speed

🎨 Customize everything from Appearance > Scroll to Top in the WordPress admin panel! 🚀

Credits

Developed by Mahyar Rad.

License

This plugin is licensed under GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/smooth-scroll-to-top/ directory or install via WordPress Plugin Installer.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Appearance > Scroll to Top to configure the button settings.
sections.faq:
How do I customize the button?

Go to Appearance > Scroll to Top in the WordPress dashboard to change colors, position, size, and shape.

Does this plugin affect page speed?

No! The plugin is lightweight and optimized for performance.

Can I change the button’s position?

Yes, you can choose to position it on the left or right and adjust its distance from the bottom and side edges.
